sentences.text:
Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.,Bharat Singh,Nagendra Kumar Singh Hon'ble Anjani Kumar Mishra,J.
Hon'ble Ms. Nand Prabha Shukla,J.
Case called out in the revised list.
None has appeared for the petitioners.
Counsel for the first informant is present.

Vide order dated 29.07.2022, the dispute had been referred for mediation as it was a matrimonial dispute giving rise to the First Information Report dated 22.05.2022, registered as Case Crime No.
0287 of 2022, under section 376 I.P.C. and 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station Civil Lines,
District Budaun.
The report of the mediation proceedings has been placed before us.
The report indicates that the mediation failed as the petitioners failed to appear before the Mediation Centre.

sentences.text:
In this regard, it is material to reproduce the relevant portion of the order dated 29.07.2022, which reads as follows:-
"
In the facts of the present case we are of the view that an attempt be made to resolve the differences between the parties by way of mediation.
It is, therefore, directed that petitioner no. 1 shall deposit a sum of Rs.10,000/- towards the expenses of mediation.
In the event such deposit is made within a week from today with the Mediation Centre, the Mediation Centre shall issue notices to both the parties.
The matter is remitted to the Mediation Centre with the direction that same may be resolved after giving notices to both the parties.

It is directed that Mediation Centre shall make all endeavours to resolve the dispute amicably, expeditiously, preferably within a period of three months.
List thereafter.
Till the next date of listing, no coercive action shall be taken against the petitioners pursuant to the aforesaid First Information Report dated 22.05.2022.
In the event of failure of compliance of this order, the petition shall stand dismissed without reference to the Court."
In view of the above and since the mediation has failed, the writ petition is dismissed as the allegation made in the First Information Report constitutes a cognizable offence.
Interim order, if any, stands discharged.
